title: Santa Anastasia excavation yields giant skeletons

tellings.quote: and the bones of giants would come out of the the site and they would put them in the in the church. They found entire skeletons of giants.

plain: Whole skeletons of giants were dug up at the Church of Santa Anastasia on the Italian island of Sardinia during an excavation between 1978 and 1981, and the bones were carried into the church. That is what the documentary filmmaker Tim Alberino tells Michels, passing on what someone there told him. If it were true, it would be physical evidence of the giants of old stories.
